cells.gaps: The successor strategy is known from the minister's presentation of its orientations on 3 April 2026 (GAB-063), the draft Stratégie nationale de Digitalisation et d'Innovation put to the technical committee on 13 May 2026 (GAB-065) and the minister's outline of a 2025-2030 plan in June 2026 (GAB-066, GAB-067); none states an adoption or a public text, and no delivery plan, reporting, body or finance row is held for it. The predecessor, Plan national stratégique Gabon Digital 2025, ended in 2025 (GAB-002); its body and finance rows (GAB-003 to GAB-005) are not carried to the new instrument.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-07: the minister's June 2026 outline gives the successor strategy a 2025-2030 period, and a draft went to the technical committee in May 2026, so it is being drafted. Stage 3 needs an adoption and a public text.
